references.text: Bet-Dagon is also mentioned as a city in the territory of the tribe of Judah, showing that this name was used for several places in Israel
The territory of the tribe of Zebulun is described here, and the border of Zebulun is mentioned in the verse as a reference to the neighboring area
Kabul is mentioned by King Solomon as the name of an area with twenty cities in Galilee that he gave to King Hiram of Tyre
This passage describes the entire territory of the tribe of Asher, of which verse 27 is part
